text:
priya: Quick sync — launching the Lightforge StarterKit micro-tutorial series + a short benchmark narrative and a 30-min webinar. Goal: 3 hands-on tutorials (local dev, Docker flow, deploy to Redwood Dedicated), tiny demo app repo, a bench post (latency & cost for small/med workloads), and a single registration landing page. Need copy, GH repo, funnel, and comms timeline. Who can own which pieces?

alex: love this. I'm happy to own the demo app + repo structure. suggest a minimal Express + client showing prompt routing to a pinned model.

jordan: I can draft the benchmark narrative — propose we highlight batching, caching, and quantization profiles used. we should pick a realistic customer-like workload (chat snippets + retrieval).

sam: I'll take the landing page + webinar funnel. quick Q: gated signup or open? gated gives leads but hurts signups. recommend open + optional email capture for webinar.

rachel: I'll handle marketing copy + social snippets. can we standardize one hero line + 3 bullets and 2 tweet drafts per publish. also need a short demo GIF for the tweet.

priya: @alex awesome. @jordan +1 on customer workload. @sam open signup sounds good — can we atomize the funnel so marketing can still seed to sales?

marco: I can wire up inbound lead routing to HubSpot. send me the webhook spec and a sample payload. also finalizing tracking UTMs.

alex: repo plan: /lightforge-starterkit with 3 folders: local-tutorial, docker-tutorial, deploy-dedicated. README includes quickstart, sample prompts, and small benchmark script. will add GH Actions for tests.

jordan: benchmark outline: 1) workload description, 2) model variants (+quant), 3) perf matrix (p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token), 4) runbook + scripts. need PR for scripts in repo.

sam: funnel flow: landing -> optional webinar signup modal -> CTA to GitHub + 1-click demo deploy (playground). After signup send 3-email drip: tutorial, deep-dive bench, invite to webinar.

rachel: draft hero options (short):
- "Lightforge StarterKit: build LLM features that stay fast and cheap"
- "Ship a real LLM demo in 30 minutes with Lightforge StarterKit"

priya: both good. rachel, pick one and write 2 headline variants for A/B.

marco: webhook sample for inbound routing (we'll map to HubSpot):
```
POST /webhooks/inbound
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "janedoe@example.com",
  "name": "Jane Doe",
  "source": "lightforge-starterkit-landing",
  "utm": "social_launch_tweet",
  "interested_in": ["starterkit","dedicated"]
}
```
marco: will add auto-tagging rules: source + utm, then route to MQL queue.

alex: for the demo GIF: short clip (15s) showing prompt -> streaming response -> latency overlay. I'll produce an MP4 + GIF.

jordan: ETA: bench draft by Tue EOD. need a small test harness — I'll PR to the repo branch bench-harness.

sam: I'll spin a Notion page for the launch checklist and wire the modal UX. need marketing images from alex by Monday.

rachel: social snippets (two tweet drafts):
1) "New: Lightforge StarterKit — step-by-step tutorials + a tiny demo app to ship LLM features fast. Try the repo + join our 30-min webinar. 🔧🚀 link"
2) "Build, benchmark, and deploy LLM demos with our StarterKit. See real latency & cost numbers, plus a live webinar. RSVP: link"

priya: timeline proposal:
- Mon: repo skeleton + hero copy (alex + rachel)
- Tue: bench harness PR (jordan) + GIF draft (alex)
- Wed: landing + funnel live (sam + marco)
- Thu: publish tutorial #1 + social tease (rachel)
- Fri: webinar + benchmark post live

sam: can we aim for Fri but keep window open next week? dependencies look tight but doable if everyone hits Tues/Wed deliverables.

priya: final asks: each owner add a 1-line status in the Notion checklist by EOD today. I'll run a 15-min launch sync tomorrow 9:30am PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:

publish-bot: Scheduled post queued: "lightforge-starterkit-launch-tease" at 2024-08-02T16:00:00Z

alex: noted — adding repo skeleton now.

jordan: working on bench harness, will tag you when PR is ready.

marco: will share webhook mapping + HubSpot flow once mapping doc is up.

rachel: drafting social copy and hero variants, will post in Notion.
